_comment: Loadout pictures (runbooth.py --phase 3). Each move's picture is chosen automatically from a burst (tools/boothburst.py): start: the fight frame the battle is held at before the first press; press: frames the button is held; gap: frames between the V-Skill and V-Trigger of one side; auto: the burst, a grab every `step` fight frames after the press up to `span`, after `settle_frames` for the cloth once the plate is taken; default: frames after the press taken when the burst shows nothing usable; fighters: OVERRIDES ONLY, an exact number of frames after the press for a move the chooser gets wrong, a number for both choices or {"1": n, "2": n} per choice, e.g. {"RYU": {"vskill": {"2": 30}, "vtrigger": 52}}; crop: the 16:9 window around the fighter and its effects, at least height_fraction of the frame high, with margin on each side.
